communication_goal: 区分首版必需功能、可选项和默认行为。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone finished educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, clean consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces and thin limbs, restrained polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, no gradients, no shading, no photographic rendering. One coherent scene, no panels. Keep all people and props in the central area approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on a 0..1000 canvas. Preserve generous empty white space at top (y<180), bottom (y>850), and sides for learning labels added later. Make the named learning props clearly recognizable and fully visible. Gestures should show a conversation. No speech balloons, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, readable code, or long text; simple abstract UI marks are allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure coworkers stand beside a desktop monitor discussing a simple settings form. One points to a single large empty square checkbox on the lower middle of the screen, the other nods with an open hand. The monitor shows only two short blank horizontal setting rows and ONE clearly recognizable large empty checkbox, with plenty of space around it. The checkbox must be fully visible, unobstructed and well separated from the bezel and any other UI marks. No letters, no icons of email words, no readable text.
